minecraft:emitter_initialization.creation_expression: v.fwd; v.right; v.up; v.speed; v.height; v.bow; v.tilt; v.life; v.color; v.alpha; v.thickness;

relative_position: t.u = (v.particle_random_1 - 0.5) * 2; t.p = math.clamp(v.particle_age / math.max(v.life, 0.01), 0, 1); t.h = v.height * (0.88 + 0.25 * t.p); t.tr = v.particle_age * v.speed + (1 - t.u * t.u) * v.bow; t.vt = (t.u + 1) * t.h; t.lt = t.u * v.tilt; return t.tr * v.fwd.x + t.lt * v.right.x + t.vt * v.up.x;
